label: MRtrix3 sh2peaks
description:
Extract the peaks of a spherical harmonic function in each voxel
Peaks of the spherical harmonic function in each voxel are located by commencing a Newton search along each of a set of pre-specified directions
The spherical harmonic coefficients are stored according the conventions described the main documentation, which can be found at the following link: 
https://mrtrix.readthedocs.io/en/3.0.8/concepts/spherical_harmonics.html

parameters.label: num
parameters.description: the number of peaks to extract (default: 3).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: threshold
parameters.description: only peak amplitudes greater than the threshold will be considered.
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

parameters.label: fast
parameters.description: use lookup table to compute associated Legendre polynomials (faster, but approximate).

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

input_slots.label: SH
input_slots.description: the input image of SH coefficients.

input_slots.label: peaks
input_slots.description: the program will try to find the peaks that most closely match those in the image provided.

input_slots.label: seeds
input_slots.description: specify a set of directions from which to start the multiple restarts of the optimisation (by default, the built-in 60 direction set is used)

input_slots.label: mask
input_slots.description: only perform computation within the specified binary brain mask image.

output_slots.label: output
output_slots.description: the output image. Each volume corresponds to the x, y & z component of each peak direction vector in turn. The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.
